title: Doc Upload Match
description: Stops a KYC upload being rejected days later by checking the file against the document asked for (Aadhaar back instead of front, Aadhaar in the PAN slot, a password-locked e-Aadhaar PDF with its password rule, a multi-page PDF, a tiny, blurry or HEIC photo, a screenshot of a screenshot) from cheap in-browser signals plus an optional classify hook, and saying exactly what to upload instead.
